nodes.title:
Calculate Direction
Target is Anim Instance

Get Actor Rotation
Target is Actor

Calculate direction using the delta between the velocity and the actor rotation. When the character is not strafing, clamp the value between - and + 45 degrees so that backwards animations do not play when turning around, but running into wall looks better.
nodes.comment: Calculate direction using the delta between the velocity and the actor rotation. When the character is not strafing, clamp the value between - and + 45 degrees so that backwards animations do not play when turning around, but running into wall looks better.
